verdict.rationale: An in-browser dev toolbar for feedback, feature flags and performance inspection is a fair axis for an app-hosting platform, since a deploy platform could ship one. However, nothing in Fly.io's evidence documents such a toolbar. The pack covers flyctl, Machines, Sprites, Managed Postgres and MCP servers, none of which relate to an on-site feedback, flags or performance overlay.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage feature flags, and inspect performance directly on my live site
